content.short: Ton Birds is a playful NFT collection and social gaming project integrated with the TON ecosystem.
content.description: Ton Birds is a charming and community-oriented NFT collection on the TON blockchain, featuring a wide variety of uniquely generated bird characters. The project focuses on social gaming and lighthearted interactions, allowing users to collect their favorite 'birds' and use them in various community-led activities and Telegram-based mini-apps. Ton Birds emphasizes the fun and social aspects of digital ownership, providing a welcoming and engaging entry point for new users to join the diverse and creative NFT world flourishing on the TON network.
content.meta: Collect and fly with Ton Birds NFTs. Playful social gaming on TON, discovered via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
